description: This file implements joystick hardware input handling for an embedded system, including external interrupt callback setup, jitter filtering, and logging of joystick events. It defines initialization routines and processes joystick button presses via GPIO pins, integrating with other system components like LCD for display updates.

methods.name: isJitter
methods.description: Detects if consecutive joystick events occur within a short time frame to filter out jitter.

methods.name: extCallback
methods.description: Handles external interrupt callback for joystick GPIO pins, updates joystick button press counts, and triggers event handling.

methods.name: joystickInfo
methods.description: Logs current statistics of joystick usage, including total presses and individual button counts.

methods.name: isJoystickEnabled
methods.description: Checks if any joystick GPIO pins are configured, indicating whether joystick input is enabled.

methods.name: initJoystick
methods.description: Initializes joystick hardware inputs, sets up external interrupts, GPIO modes, and registers console commands.
